content.content:
Where a node's content.ref is a list of repo-relative paths rather than "inline", the Content section's value is the content type together with those paths, in the monospaced block qwzwpxws settles for that path form (qwzwpxws). Each of those paths is an activatable entry: activating a path opens, in the editor, the repo-relative file that path names.

The entry is the path the section already shows, on every value of that form whatever its content type, because qwzwpxws presents the path form in one block for every type. This decision neither withholds, replaces nor reorders a path in that block, and it introduces no body for a node whose body lives in the referenced files: activation changes nothing about the value the section shows. Nothing else in the block is an entry — the content type shown beside the paths names the type and is not a path, so it is not activatable — and a node whose content.ref is "inline" shows no path and so offers nothing to activate here.

Activation means either of two equivalent inputs on that path: a pointer click, or Enter or Space while the path's entry has focus. The two do the same thing — neither is a variant of the other, a modifier or a second mode, and neither is a double-click — and both have the one outcome: the file the path names opens in the editor. Because the path is activatable, the entry is a control the keyboard can reach and invoke rather than inert text in the block, and focus landing on the entry is what makes the keyboard input possible at all.

The outcome is this entry's own, and it is not a selection. Activating a path opens a file; it does not select the node whose detail is being shown, does not change which node the panel shows, and does not scroll or zoom the canvas. Nothing here extends the relationship sections' activation to the Content section: a path shown there is not one of the ids listed in "depends_on", "evaluates", "dependents" or "evaluators", this decision does not claim that activation of a listed id covers the Content section or the paths in it, and activation of a listed id stays exactly what kwxutvpw records — the node that id names is selected and its detail shown, with no document opened (kwxutvpw). Activation of a path here stays the other way round: a file opens, and no node is selected and no detail shown differently.

The canvas's double-click keeps its own requirement unchanged (trxzsqpv): a double-click on a node still opens nodes/<id>.json in the editor, and this decision neither replaces that requirement, represses it, nor re-triggers it. A path's activation is not that requirement and not a variant of it: it is one pointer click on a path in the panel, or Enter or Space on that focused entry, it uses no double-click, and the double-click's trigger continues to open the node's own document rather than any path the node's ref list carries.

Activation does nothing else, and this decision settles nothing adjacent. The entry keeps the look the paths already have: no class, no style rule, no hover cue and no focus indicator is added here — the one appearance requirement is the one the keyboard input needs in order to exist at all, that the entry is focusable — and how an entry is drawn is left to the stylesheet decisions that own appearance. Nor is anything stated for a path that names no file: this decision states activation for a path the section shows because the node's ref list records it. The paths stay as qwzwpxws presents them, in the order that value gives them, and each one is a control in exactly that place.
content.rationale: qwzwpxws settled the Content section's path form as a presentation and left it inert: a node whose body lives in files shows the content type and the repo-relative paths, so a reader can see where the body is but cannot reach it from the panel, and trxzsqpv's double-click reaches a different file entirely — the node's own nodes/<id>.json, not the sources its ref list names. The one place in the panel that spells a path out exactly is therefore the one place no recorded trigger acts on. This decision closes that gap at the cheapest surface available: the path the section already shows becomes a control, with the same two inputs and the same one-outcome, no-variant discipline the panel's other activatable entries use (kwxutvpw), but with its own entry and its own outcome, because a path is not a listed id and opening a file is not the selection a listed id makes. Borrowing that vocabulary rather than inventing a second one keeps the panel's activation story single — a pointer click or Enter or Space on a focused control — while the scoping keeps the two commitments apart: nothing here extends the relationship sections' activation to the Content section, and nothing here re-triggers or reshapes the double-click, which continues to open the node's own document. The node settles one input pair, one outcome, and the entry's focusability, and deliberately leaves appearance to the stylesheet decisions that own it and unknown paths to their own commitment, so it introduces no transport, resolution, styling or scope rule that its three prerequisites do not state.
